notes: Commitment library by issue category. Phrases are written to be specific and checkable. Edit deliberately; say why in the commit.

water.headline: Water-positive campus
commitments: Closed-loop or air-cooled design with near-zero water draw for cooling
Public, real-time water-use dashboard
Fund local water-supply resilience projects
water.pitch: Cooling that draws close to no water keeps the campus off {county}'s supply, which residents rank as a top concern.

infrastructure.headline: Road-first campus
commitments: Annual county road-repair fund, sized to the project's tax contribution
Construction traffic plan that keeps trucks off residential roads
Intersection upgrades at the site entrance before construction starts
infrastructure.pitch: A dedicated road fund turns part of the project's tax contribution into the repairs residents keep asking for.

education.headline: School-partner campus
commitments: Technical-education partnership with local high schools
Paid internships for students in the program
Contribution to school capacity tied to the project's tax revenue
education.pitch: A technical program with local schools links the campus to what families care about.

jobs.headline: Local-jobs campus
commitments: Skilled-trades apprenticeship program with local colleges
Local-hiring target for construction and operations, reported publicly
Hiring pipeline for program graduates
jobs.pitch: An apprenticeship program and public local-hiring targets put the jobs where residents can see them.

energy_costs.headline: Pay-our-own-way campus
commitments: Pay the full cost of grid upgrades the project requires
Accept a large-load tariff so residential rates don't absorb the project
Reduce load during grid peaks when the utility asks
energy_costs.pitch: Paying its full grid costs and flexing during peaks keeps the project off residents' electricity bills.

health.headline: Zero-combustion campus
commitments: No on-site combustion generation; grid power with battery backup
Independent air-quality monitoring near the site, published online
Community health liaison with quarterly public updates
health.pitch: No on-site turbines means none of the emissions behind past local backlash, verified by independent monitoring.

environment.headline: Clean-power campus
commitments: Match consumption with new clean-energy procurement in the region
Restore habitat on unused parts of the parcel
Annual environmental report, independently reviewed
environment.pitch: New clean-power procurement and on-site restoration answer residents' environmental concerns directly.

housing.headline: Housing-partner campus
commitments: Contribution to a local workforce-housing fund
Housing support for construction crews so they don't strain rentals
Partnership with the county on housing near the site
housing.pitch: A workforce-housing fund keeps construction and new jobs from pushing up local rents.

public_safety.headline: Safety-partner campus
commitments: Fund equipment and training for local fire and EMS
Joint emergency plan with county responders
On-site safety drills with local departments
public_safety.pitch: Funding for fire and EMS makes the project a visible contributor to local safety.

other.headline: Community-partner campus
commitments: Written community benefits agreement with annual public reporting
other.pitch: A written benefits agreement commits the project to what residents raised.

noise: Sound walls and low-noise cooling on residential edges
Published noise limits with independent monitoring
water use: Closed-loop or air-cooled design with near-zero water draw for cooling
air quality: No on-site combustion generation; grid power with battery backup
energy costs: Pay the full cost of grid upgrades the project requires
transmission lines: Route new lines along existing corridors where possible, with public input on routing
land use: Landscaped buffers and building heights reviewed with neighbors

site_rules.high_water_risk_commitment: Closed-loop or air-cooled design with near-zero water draw for cooling
